queries.Context: To address the central question: Optogenetic stimulation of ventral tegmental area dopamine neurons and dorsal raphe serotonin neurons with fiber photometry using genetically encoded dopamine and serotonin sensors in nucleus accumbens and dorsal striatum to measure bidirectional dopamine and serotonin release, combined with acute slice whole-cell electrophysiology to characterize synaptic crosstalk between dopaminergic and serotonergic systems.
queries.Context: To test causal effects of dopam: causal effects of optogenetic VTA dopamine neuron stimulation on striatal dopamine and serotonin release measured by fiber photometry in DAT-Cre mice
queries.Context: To test causal effects of serot: optogenetic activation of dorsal raphe SERT serotonergic neurons in SERT-Cre mice and striatal dopamine and serotonin release measured by fiber photometry in nucleus accumbens and dorsal striatum
queries.Context: To identify synaptic mechanisms: Whole-cell patch-clamp recordings in acute brain slices to examine excitatory synaptic connections, glutamate co-release from dorsal raphe serotonergic neurons, striatal projections, optogenetic stimulation, glutamate receptor blockers
queries.Context: To map regional synaptic inputs: optogenetic projection targeting combined with whole-cell recordings to characterize glutamatergic excitatory synaptic currents from dorsal raphe SERT serotonergic neurons onto dorsal striatum, nucleus accumbens shell, orbitofrontal cortex, and ventral tegmental area in acute mouse brain slices
queries.Context: To isolate excitatory synaptic: optogenetic stimulation of dorsal raphe SERT serotonergic neurons with whole-cell patch-clamp recordings in acute slices using NBQX and AP5 to block glutamatergic transmission and identify excitatory synaptic connections onto striatal, nucleus accumbens, orbitofrontal cortex, and VTA neurons
queries.Context: To enable cell-type-specific ma: Use of DAT-IRES-Cre and SERT-Cre transgenic mice to enable cell-type-specific optogenetic targeting of dopaminergic and serotonergic neurons for studying striatal dopamine and serotonin crosstalk
queries.Context: To express an optogenetic actua: optogenetic activation of VTA dopaminergic neurons in DAT-Cre mice and DRN serotonergic neurons in SERT-Cre mice using AAV8-syn-Flex-ChrimsonR-tdTomato to study striatal dopamine and serotonin crosstalk
queries.Context: To measure striatal neurotransm: real-time striatal dopamine and serotonin release monitoring using AAV5-CAG-dLight1.2 and AAV9-hSyn-5-HT3.0 genetically encoded sensors in nucleus accumbens and dorsal striatum during optogenetic stimulation of VTA dopamine and DRN serotonin neurons
queries.Context: To standardize optogenetic acti: standardized optogenetic stimulation protocol for VTA dopamine and DRN serotonin neurons using pulsed laser bursts to measure striatal dopamine and serotonin release with fiber photometry
queries.Context: To validate in vivo sensor resp: real-time in vivo fiber photometry of striatal dopamine and serotonin dynamics with genetically encoded sensors during optogenetic stimulation and passive cocaine injection positive control
queries.Context: To prepare mice for in vivo rec: three-day mouse habituation to handling and tethered connection cables before in vivo fiber photometry and optogenetic stimulation of dopamine and serotonin neurons in striatum
queries.Context: To standardize the in vivo reco: In vivo fiber photometry recording protocol in mice using transparent open-field chamber with habituation, baseline recording, optogenetic stimulation of midbrain dopamine or serotonin neurons, additional baseline, intraperitoneal cocaine injection as positive control, and prolonged post-injection recording to measure striatal neurotransmitter dynamics.
queries.Context: To quantify in vivo neurotransm: Fiber photometry analysis of striatal dopamine and serotonin signals using MATLAB, computing delta F/F, baseline normalization, area under the curve in five-second windows, and peak responses after optogenetic stimulation compared with cocaine injection.
queries.Context: To quantify excitatory synaptic: Whole-cell patch-clamp recordings of optogenetically evoked excitatory postsynaptic currents in acute striatal or midbrain slices using single and paired light pulses at 0.1 Hz with picrotoxin to block inhibitory transmission and isolate glutamatergic synaptic responses from serotonergic or dopaminergic projection neurons
